structured.answer: You can take it out tax-free 6 years after the first deposit; on the page's example (300 ₪ from me, 900 from the employer a month) after 5 years you'd be left with roughly 66,500 ₪, though at 5 years tax eats around 14,000, so I'd wait for 6.
